outcome: Pelvic pain (Visual Analog Scale, McGill Pain Questionnaire)
Scar appearance (Vancouver Scar Scale, Patient Scar Assessment Scale)
cohort: A sample of 15 women (mean age 33.1 years) experiencing pelvic pain due to scars from perineal tears, episiotomies, or caesarean sections.
finding: Collagen infiltrations resulted in a greater decrease in pelvic pain, specifically in the PRI-Sensorial subscale of the McGill Pain Questionnaire, and showed potential to improve pain and scar appearance.
